description: Authenticated read-only Linura observation reflects authoritative systemd state changes and NetworkManager state when available.

steps.name: observation-runtime-present
steps.command: command -v linurad >/dev/null && command -v linuractl >/dev/null && command -v dbus-run-session >/dev/null && command -v systemd-run >/dev/null && sudo -n true

steps.name: authenticated-authoritative-observation
steps.command: dbus-run-session -- bash -euo pipefail -c 'daemon=; unit=linura-observation-acceptance-$$.service; cleanup() { if [[ -n "$daemon" ]]; then kill "$daemon" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$daemon" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; sudo -n systemctl stop "$unit" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; sudo -n systemctl reset-failed "$unit" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }; trap cleanup EXIT; linurad >/tmp/linurad-acceptance.log 2>&1 & daemon=$!; ready=0; for _ in $(seq 1 50); do if linuractl capabilities >/tmp/linura-capabilities 2>/dev/null; then ready=1; break; fi; sleep 0.1; done; if [[ "$ready" -ne 1 ]]; then cat /tmp/linurad-acceptance.log >&2; exit 1; fi; linuractl whoami >/tmp/linura-whoami; grep -F "uid=$(id -u)" /tmp/linura-whoami; grep -F "actor_kind=service" /tmp/linura-whoami; grep -F "provider=systemd" /tmp/linura-capabilities; grep -F "capability=systemd.unit.observe" /tmp/linura-capabilities; sudo -n systemd-run --unit="${unit%.service}" --property=RemainAfterExit=yes /usr/bin/true >/dev/null; first=$(linuractl observe "systemd:unit:$unit"); grep -F "provider=systemd" <<<"$first"; grep -F "authority=native-api" <<<"$first"; grep -F "freshness=current" <<<"$first"; grep -F "attribute.active_state=active" <<<"$first"; explanation=$(linuractl explain "systemd:unit:$unit"); grep -F "provider=systemd" <<<"$explanation"; graph=$(linuractl graph); grep -F "resource:systemd:unit:$unit" <<<"$graph"; sudo -n systemctl stop "$unit"; second=$(linuractl observe "systemd:unit:$unit"); grep -F "attribute.active_state=inactive" <<<"$second"; if awk '''BEGIN{p=0} /^provider=networkmanager$/{p=1;next} p && /^availability=available$/{found=1;exit} /^provider=/{p=0} END{exit found?0:1}''' /tmp/linura-capabilities; then nm=$(linuractl observe networkmanager:manager); grep -F "provider=networkmanager" <<<"$nm"; grep -F "authority=native-api" <<<"$nm"; grep -F "freshness=current" <<<"$nm"; grep -F "attribute.state=" <<<"$nm"; fi'
